map.ETP 低一定出血吗？: Does a low ETP always mean bleeding?
map.ETP 降低提示总凝血酶生成不足，见于血友病、抗凝治疗或肝病；但需结合 Peak: A low ETP indicates insufficient total thrombin generation, seen in haemophilia, anticoagulant therapy or liver disease. But it must be read together with Peak and clinical bleeding signs: a low ETP alone does not equal active bleeding, and in haemophilia the replacement dose is adjusted against ETP targets.
map.TGA 能替代常规凝血筛查吗？: Can TGA replace routine coagulation screening?
map.不能替代，二者互补。TGA 提供「全程凝血酶量」视角，对高凝态与因子替代充分性更: No, the two are complementary. TGA gives a view of overall thrombin amount and is more sensitive to hypercoagulable states and factor replacement adequacy, while routine PT/APTT looks at the initiation phase. Interpretation must combine clinical findings and standardised reference intervals.
